titleEn: Minimum Index Sum of Two Lists
title: 两个列表的最小索引总和
summary: 两个无重复餐厅列表按喜好排序，找出在两列表中索引和最小的所有共同餐厅。
insight: 记录第一列表每个名称的索引，再扫描第二列表即可在线比较共同名称的索引和。
pitfalls: 可能有多个并列最优餐厅
只返回两个列表都出现的名称
结果顺序不影响原题判定

solutions.title: 索引哈希表与单次扫描
solutions.idea: 用第一列表索引表快速计算第二列表中共同项的索引和。
steps: 扫描 list2，遇共同项计算 indexSum
更小时清空结果，相等时追加，最终转数组

code.java: class Solution { public String[] findRestaurant(String[] list1,String[] list2){Map<String,Integer> indices=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<list1.length;i++)indices.put(list1[i],i);List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();int best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=0;i<list2.length;i++){Integer first=indices.get(list2[i]);if(first==null)continue;int sum=first+i;if(sum<best){best=sum;answer.clear();answer.add(list2[i]);}else if(sum==best)answer.add(list2[i]);}return answer.toArray(new String[0]);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findRestaurant(list1:Array<String>,list2:Array<String>):Array<String>{val indices=list1.withIndex().associate{it.value to it.index};val answer=mutableListOf<String>();var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;for((index,name) in list2.withIndex()){val first=indices[name]?:continue;val sum=first+index;if(sum<best){best=sum;answer.clear();answer.add(name)}else if(sum==best)answer.add(name)};return answer.toTypedArray()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> findRestaurant(vector<string>& list1,vector<string>& list2){unordered_map<string,int> indices;for(int i=0;i<(int)list1.size();++i)indices[list1[i]]=i;vector<string> answer;int best=INT_MAX;for(int i=0;i<(int)list2.size();++i)if(indices.count(list2[i])){int sum=indices[list2[i]]+i;if(sum<best){best=sum;answer.clear();answer.push_back(list2[i]);}else if(sum==best)answer.push_back(list2[i]);}return answer;} };
